definitions.gloss: memorial service, prayers for the dead, offering to the deceased
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist ritual or practice of making offerings and praying for the repose of the dead. Can also extend to honoring inanimate objects that have served their purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{供養|くよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To hold a memorial service for one's ancestors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{命日|めいにち}→命日：17539_meinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{供養|くよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We hold a memorial service every year on the anniversary of the death.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{供養|くよう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: We had old dolls given a memorial ceremony at the temple.

notes:
GRAMMAR: Functions as a noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({供養|くよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧{供養|くよう} (memorial service for ancestors)
- {供養|くよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to hold a memorial service)
- {水子|みずこ}{供養|くよう} (memorial for miscarried/aborted children)
- {針|はり}{供養|くよう} (needle memorial ceremony)
- ⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧{供養|くよう} (doll memorial ceremony)

CULTURAL: In Japanese Buddhism, {供養|くよう} is not limited to human deaths. There are ceremonies for broken needles ({針|はり}{供養|くよう}), old dolls, and even used chopsticks, reflecting the belief that objects develop a spirit after long use.
